findings.acceptance: CLI usage documentation describes the table, color meaning, and plain-text fallback accurately
findings.summary: TTY color documentation omits the recognized-capability allowlist and overstates when ANSI is enabled.
findings.detail: The documentation says TTY output uses ANSI unless TERM=dumb or NO_COLOR is set. The implementation additionally requires a recognized TERM prefix, TERM_PROGRAM value, or Windows ANSI signal. Unknown TERM values without those signals receive plain text.
findings.requested_change: Document that color is enabled only when a recognized terminal capability signal is present, and that unknown terminals fall back to plain text.

acceptance_results.terminal_table: Met by static inspection: renderer emits FD, status, priority, and title columns without Markdown table syntax.
acceptance_results.active_and_archived_sources: Met by static inspection: fd_list_rows uses all_files and extracts row values from FD documents.
acceptance_results.redundant_color: Met by static inspection: color wraps only status and priority; disabled color returns the original values.
acceptance_results.color_fallbacks: Implementation met statically: non-TTY, NO_COLOR, and TERM=dumb disable ANSI; unknown TERM values need an allowlisted TERM prefix, recognized TERM_PROGRAM, or Windows ANSI signal. User-facing docs have the finding above.
acceptance_results.safe_title_rendering: Met by static inspection: Cc/Cf characters are removed and unrepresentable stdout characters use backslashreplace.
acceptance_results.read_only_and_dependencies: Met by static inspection: listing reads FD files and uses standard-library unicodedata; no list-path writes were found.
acceptance_results.documentation: Partially met: table fields and plain-text fallback are described, but the TTY color condition is broader than implementation behavior.
